hooks.command: PLUGIN_VERSION='1.0.4'; if ! command -v crux >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Installing crux-cli...'; uv tool install crux-cli; crux init 2>/dev/null; elif [ "$(crux version 2>&1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+')" != "$PLUGIN_VERSION" ]; then echo "Upgrading crux-cli to v${PLUGIN_VERSION}..."; uv tool install --force crux-cli==${PLUGIN_VERSION}; fi
